parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: the StoreError raised by delete in sign_out_everywhere is caught and only logged, so sessions remain valid and change_password (which calls sign_out_everywhere) returns normally, leaving the caller unaware that sign-out was incomplete. Description A adds mention of the refresh token, but the root cause and location are the same.
